fibonacci.description: Recursive fib(40), stressing scalar function calls.

vector_sum.description: Grow a dynamic integer array to one million elements then sum it.

threads.description: Four concurrent CPU workers, joined before summing their outputs.

hot_loop.description: 200 million integer multiply/add/modulo iterations to reduce process-startup noise.

lambda_map.description: Build one million integers, map a lambda over them, then sum the transformed array.

pointer_rc.description: Five million copies/dereferences of the language's ordinary safe shared-lifetime pointer/reference mechanism.

pointer_rc_long.description: Fifty million copies/dereferences of the language's ordinary safe shared-lifetime pointer/reference mechanism, reducing process-startup noise.

hash_map.description: Hash-map insert and lookup over 200k integer pairs.

ordered_map.description: Ordered-map insert and lookup over 200k integer pairs.

hash_set.description: Hash-set insert and membership over 200k integers.

priority_queue_ops.description: Max-first priority queue push/top/pop over 200k integers.

queue_ops_long.description: Push and pop two million integers through the language queue abstraction.

hash_set_long.description: Hash-set insert and membership over two million integers.

priority_queue_ops_long.description: Max-first priority queue push/top/pop over two million integers.
